note: Rustic campground in the forested foothills on the Forestry Trunk Road (Hwy 40), about 72 km north of Hwy 1A, with vehicle sites on the north side of Burnt Timber Creek and walk-in tent sites on the south side. Run by Red Rock Sawmills; free firewood; the hand pump is for putting out fires only. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Jun 5, 2026) and Red Rock Sawmills' page: C$40 per unit, first-come only, no services, vault toilets, non-potable pump; 22 vehicle + 8 walk-in sites (count 22 written); season May 1 - Sep 8 (derived Sep 30 -> Sep 8; operator closes the Monday a week after Labour Day). Phone 587-830-2198 confirmed. Not waterfront kept (canopy-blind; creekside lead logged).
flags: SEASON: AP 'Season: May 1 - Sep 8'; operator 'closes one week after the September Long on the following Monday' (Sep 14 in 2026). Wrote 05-01..09-08 with the operator's rule in season.note; the two official pages differ by about a week.
SITES: AP table 'Unserviced 28'; operator 'Total Campground Sites: 30' = 22 trailer/tent sites north of the creek + 8 walk-in tent sites. Wrote count 22 (vehicle sites only).
PHONE: stored 587-830-2198 matches the page's 'Information: 587-830-2198' and the operator (Facility Operator: Red Rock Sawmills). Confirmed.
WEBSITE: stored AP camping page answered 200 and is this campground. Operator page (200, this campground): https://www.redrocksawmill.com/burnt-timber - could be added.
SENIORS LINE: PRESENT ('This campground qualifies for the camping fee discount for Alberta seniors.').

WATERFRONT LEAD (stored not waterfront; kept): the page says 'A creek runs through the campground' and the operator 'Creekside Setting: Several sites are close to Burnt Timber Creek'. On Esri imagery the stored pin is in unbroken conifer canopy ~100 m NW of the creek, with a pale gravel band (bar or the campground road) along the creek's NW bank; no spurs or pads are visible through the canopy and no site map was found. Water at the pads cannot be established, so not waterfront stays under the unsure-goes-down rule; a site map or photos naming creek-bank sites would be needed.
PIN (51.58986,-115.17051): matches the AP directions point 51.589855,-115.170512; the operator's GPS 51.58977,-115.16871 is ~125 m east. Canopy hides the loop; no move recommended (under 250 m).
KANANASKIS CONSERVATION PASS: the page (under the 'kananaskis' region path) does not mention the pass; nothing written.
